About Highbrook

Your East Tāmaki warehouse, connected to the whole country.

MOVe Highbrook is one of two MOVe warehouses in East Tāmaki, alongside our Jarvis Way site. Containers are unloaded here, orders are picked and packed, and freight leaves for the rest of New Zealand through the MOVe freight network.

MOVe Logistics Group is listed on the NZX (MOV), with its head office in Bell Block, New Plymouth.

The Highbrook story in your own words: floor area, racking and pallet spaces, temperature or bond options if any, the systems customers use to see their stock, and the kinds of businesses stored here today.‡

Why a 3PL in East Tāmaki

Store it in Auckland. Deliver it anywhere.

East Tāmaki is one of Auckland's main industrial and logistics areas. Keeping stock at Highbrook puts it in the country's largest market, with MOVe freight ready to take it north or south.‡ Add the travel times to the port, the airport and the motorway that matter to your customers.

Warehousing and 3PL in Auckland

MOVe runs two warehouses in East Tāmaki and a freight branch in Wiri. Importing, selling online or supplying stores nationwide, we can store, pick and deliver your stock.

Questions buyers ask about warehousing in Auckland

Answers built from what MOVe publishes. Lines marked ‡ are for MOVe to complete.Workbook · Local answers
How much does 3PL warehousing cost in Auckland?+

It depends on how much space you need, how long stock stays and how often it moves in and out. Send us your monthly volumes and we will quote.‡ MOVe to add how pricing is worked out, for example per pallet per week plus handling.

Can you unload my containers and deliver nationwide?+

Yes. Highbrook does container devanning and container loading, and stock goes out nationwide through the MOVe freight network of 17 freight branches.

Do you do pick and pack for online stores?+

Yes. Highbrook offers order picking, including pick and pack, with nationwide distribution from the same site. Which online store platforms we connect to:‡

What should I check before choosing a 3PL in Auckland?+

Check that one site can handle everything you need (devanning, storage, picking and delivery), the opening hours, how you will see your stock levels, how damage and insurance are handled, and how far they can deliver. At Highbrook, the hours are 6am to 6pm on weekdays and delivery runs nationwide.‡

Where are your Auckland warehouses?+

Two in East Tāmaki: 30 Highbrook Drive, Auckland 2013, and 20 Jarvis Way, Auckland 2019. The Auckland freight branch is at 63 McLaughlins Road, Wiri.

What are your opening hours at Highbrook?+

Monday to Friday, 6am to 6pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
